description: This file defines configuration classes for setting up SQS streaming in Orleans, including configurators for silos and cluster clients, with methods to configure SQS options, cache, and partitioning.

classes.name: SiloSqsStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Configurator for setting up SQS streaming on silos, allowing configuration of SQS options, cache size, and partitioning.

classes.name: ClusterClientSqsStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Configurator for setting up SQS streaming on cluster clients, allowing configuration of SQS options and partitioning.

methods.name: ConfigureSqs
methods.description: Configures SQS options using a provided configuration action.

methods.name: ConfigureCache
methods.description: Configures cache size for the SQS stream.

methods.name: ConfigurePartitioning
methods.description: Configures the number of partitions (queues) for the SQS stream.
